entries.title: Acronyms and Basic Anatomy Review
do_not_test: Acronym list and endocrine-organ overview figure - reference material, not an independently testable competency.
entries.zero_question_reason: Pure glossary and anatomy-overview content; retained as scope for framing other units, no standalone clinical competency.

entries.title: Overview of Lipid Transport

testable_competencies.lipid_transport: Recognize the basic physiology of lipoprotein classes and lipid transport as background for interpreting a lipid panel.

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal physiology background; not independently testable but retained to frame the dyslipidemia units that follow.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 74's lifestyle-modification and screening enabling objectives implicitly require distinguishing primary/genetic from secondary dyslipidemia when interpreting an abnormal lipid screen; primary dyslipidemias are rare, named single-cause disorders (e.g. familial hypercholesterolemia) mapped as COMPONENT/MODERATE given the absence of a dedicated MCC lipid-disorder objective.

testable_competencies.primary_dyslipidemia_recognition: Recognize rare monogenic dyslipidemias (e.g. familial hypercholesterolemia, familial combined hyperlipidemia) and their distinguishing features from common secondary dyslipidemia.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Secondary dyslipidemia identification (diabetes, hypothyroidism, nephrotic syndrome, medications) is a component of the periodic-health/preventive-screening enabling objective's requirement to identify modifiable cardiovascular risk factors.

testable_competencies.secondary_dyslipidemia: Identify and treat underlying causes of secondary dyslipidemia (diabetes, hypothyroidism, nephrotic syndrome, cholestasis, medications) before or alongside lipid-lowering therapy.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 74's enabling objectives require age/sex-specific screening investigations; cardiovascular risk stratification using a lipid panel to guide statin initiation is a named preventive-health screening task.

testable_competencies.cv_risk_stratification: Apply a validated cardiovascular risk calculator incorporating lipid levels to determine statin-therapy eligibility for primary prevention.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 74 explicitly lists lipid screening and lifestyle/pharmacologic risk-factor modification among its enabling objectives for periodic health encounters; statin-based dyslipidemia treatment is core, high-frequency preventive-medicine management.

testable_competencies.lipid_lowering_therapy: Select first-line lipid-lowering pharmacotherapy (statin intensity by risk category) and recognize statin-associated myopathy/LFT monitoring.

entries.title: Overview of Glucose Regulation

testable_competencies.glucose_physiology: Recognize the insulin/glucagon-mediated glucose homeostasis physiology underlying diabetes and hypoglycemia.

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal physiology background framing the glucose-metabolism disorder units that follow; not independently testable.

entries.title: Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance / Impaired Fasting Glucose)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 130's causal_conditions list diabetes mellitus and its key task includes 'prevention of progression of pre-diabetes'; IFG/IGT diagnostic criteria and progression-risk counselling are a named enabling sub-task of the broader hyperglycemia objective rather than a fully independent presentation.

testable_competencies.prediabetes_dx: Apply Diabetes Canada 2018 diagnostic criteria (IFG, IGT, A1c) to diagnose pre-diabetes and counsel on lifestyle modification/metformin to reduce progression to diabetes.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 130's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Diabetes mellitus (type 1, type 2, gestational)' and its enabling objectives require distinguishing acute/chronic hyperglycemia, identifying emergent situations, and using critical investigations - a direct match to this unit's classification framework and Diabetes Canada 2018 diagnostic criteria (FPG, A1c, OGTT, random PG).

testable_competencies.dm_classification: Classify diabetes mellitus by etiology (T1DM, T2DM, other specific causes, gestational) using clinical and genetic distinguishing features.
testable_competencies.dm_diagnosis: Apply Diabetes Canada 2018 diagnostic criteria (FPG >=7.0, A1c >=6.5%, 2h OGTT >=11.1, or random PG >=11.1 with symptoms) to diagnose diabetes mellitus.

entries.title: Treatment of Diabetes: Glycemic Targets, Lifestyle, and Pharmacotherapy

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 130's key task explicitly requires the candidate to 'initiate an appropriate management plan' for hyperglycemia; this unit's individualized A1c targets, stepwise non-insulin antihyperglycemic therapy, and insulin regimen selection is the objective's core management-planning enabling objective in its fullest depth.

testable_competencies.glycemic_targets: Individualize A1c targets by patient frailty, functional dependence, and hypoglycemia risk.
testable_competencies.stepwise_pharmacotherapy: Select initial and add-on non-insulin antihyperglycemic therapy for T2DM using the stepwise algorithm (metformin first-line, then SGLT2i/GLP-1RA/DPP-4i/sulfonylurea/TZD/insulin by patient factors).
testable_competencies.insulin_regimen_selection: Select and titrate basal, basal-bolus, or premixed insulin regimens for T1DM and T2DM, and apply sick-day medication-holding rules (SADMANS).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 130's enabling objectives explicitly require the candidate to 'identify emergent situations (e.g., diabetic ketoacidosis, hyperosmolar state)' as a named priority task, directly matching this unit's DKA/HHS precipitant recognition and acute management.

testable_competencies.dka_recognition: Recognize DKA precipitants ('8 I's') and initiate emergency management (fluids, insulin, potassium repletion).
testable_competencies.hhs_vs_dka: Distinguish hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state from DKA by degree of ketosis/acidosis and typical patient population.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 9-1's causal_conditions explicitly list diabetes as a cardiovascular risk factor context; diabetic macrovascular disease (CAD, cerebrovascular disease, PAD) is a component of the broader hypertension/cardiovascular-risk objective rather than named independently.

testable_competencies.macrovascular_screening: Recognize diabetes as a coronary artery disease risk-equivalent and screen for/manage macrovascular risk factors (blood pressure, lipids, smoking cessation, antiplatelet therapy where indicated).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 89-2's causal_conditions explicitly name 'diabetic nephropathy' as a glomerular cause of CKD; diabetic microvascular screening (retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy) is the preventive/early-detection task underlying this objective's staging and management requirement.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 130's key task requires attention to 'prevention of complications', matching this unit's microvascular screening intervals and management.

testable_competencies.diabetic_retinopathy: Recognize the need for regular ophthalmologic screening in diabetes to detect retinopathy before vision loss.
testable_competencies.diabetic_nephropathy: Screen for diabetic nephropathy with urine albumin-creatinine ratio and eGFR, and initiate ACEi/ARB or SGLT2i for renoprotection.
testable_competencies.diabetic_neuropathy: Recognize peripheral and autonomic diabetic neuropathy and perform annual diabetic foot examination.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Component of Objective 130's broader 'complications' task, covering diabetes-associated complications (e.g. diabetic foot infection, gastroparesis, increased infection susceptibility) not classified as macro- or microvascular.

testable_competencies.other_dm_complications: Recognize additional diabetes-associated complications (diabetic foot, gastroparesis, increased infection risk) requiring surveillance.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 129 is a direct, exact-title match; its key objective ('initiate an appropriate management plan while diagnosing the cause... management should be prioritized and initiated even before a cause is identified') matches this unit's Whipple's-triad workup and glucagon/D50W emergency treatment precisely.

testable_competencies.hypoglycemia_workup: Apply Whipple's triad and a supervised fast/mixed-meal test with insulin, C-peptide, and proinsulin to distinguish endogenous hyperinsulinism (insulinoma) from exogenous causes.
testable_competencies.hypoglycemia_treatment: Treat hypoglycemia urgently with oral carbohydrate, D50W IV, or glucagon IM/SC, prioritizing treatment over diagnosis in the acute setting.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Metabolic syndrome (central obesity, hypertension, dyslipidemia, hyperglycemia clustering) is a component risk-clustering concept spanning Objective 130 (hyperglycemia), 9-1 (hypertension), and lipid-related preventive screening rather than a named MCC objective of its own.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 118-1's causal_conditions list neuroendocrine/metabolic factors in weight abnormality; central obesity is a defining metabolic syndrome criterion.

testable_competencies.metsyn_criteria: Apply diagnostic criteria for metabolic syndrome (waist circumference, triglycerides, HDL, blood pressure, fasting glucose) and counsel on lifestyle-based risk reduction.

entries.title: Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis Physiology

testable_competencies.hp_axis_physiology: Recognize hypothalamic-pituitary-target-organ axis physiology (anterior/posterior pituitary hormones and their regulation) as background for the pituitary, thyroid, and adrenal disease units.

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal endocrine-axis physiology; the TSH and ACTH TOC entries folded into this unit are pure cross-reference stubs with their substantive disease content represented under Thyroid (SU-E-23 onward) and Adrenal Cortex (SU-E-36 onward).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 101's causal_conditions explicitly list 'Endocrine (e.g., excess growth hormone)' for tall stature; GH deficiency (childhood short stature) and GH excess (acromegaly/gigantism) are the named endocrine etiologies of this abnormal-stature objective.

testable_competencies.gh_deficiency: Diagnose GH deficiency using IGF-1 levels and provocative testing (insulin tolerance test), and recognize when adult GH replacement is indicated.
testable_competencies.gh_excess: Recognize acromegaly (adults) and gigantism (children) as GH-excess presentations and initiate appropriate workup.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 56-1's causal_conditions list 'Pituitary' causes of amenorrhea; hyperprolactinemia is a classic named cause of secondary amenorrhea via GnRH suppression, matching this unit's hypogonadism-from-prolactin-excess content.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 10-1 explicitly covers 'gynecomastia' and hormonal breast-symptom causes; prolactin-driven galactorrhea is a directly analogous hormonal breast-symptom presentation.

testable_competencies.hyperprolactinemia_workup: Investigate hyperprolactinemia (medication review, TSH, hCG, macroprolactin, MRI sella) and select dopamine-agonist therapy for prolactinoma.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 46's causal_conditions explicitly list 'hypogonadotropic hypogonadism' as a female ovulatory-dysfunction cause of infertility; this unit covers the same central endocrine mechanism (impaired GnRH/LH/FSH release) applicable to both sexes.

testable_competencies.hypogonadotropic_hypogonadism: Recognize hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (Kallmann syndrome, pituitary tumour/apoplexy, drug-induced) by low LH/FSH with low sex-hormone levels, and initiate hormone-replacement therapy.

entries.title: Antidiuretic Hormone Disorders: Diabetes Insipidus and SIADH

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 110-2's causal_conditions explicitly list 'diabetes insipidus: central versus nephrogenic' as a named cause of polyuria, directly matching this unit's central/nephrogenic DI etiology and fluid-deprivation/DDAVP diagnostic workup.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 99-2 covers hyponatremia broadly and this unit's SIADH-vs-cerebral-salt-wasting differential is a classic, high-yield cause of severe hyponatremia matching the objective's life-threatening-hyponatremia recognition task.

testable_competencies.di_workup: Distinguish central from nephrogenic diabetes insipidus using fluid-deprivation testing and response to exogenous DDAVP.
testable_competencies.siadh_vs_csw: Differentiate SIADH from cerebral salt wasting using volume status, the key distinguishing feature (euvolemic vs. hypovolemic).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Pituitary adenoma mass effect and hypopituitarism produce axis-specific deficiencies including GH deficiency (Objective 101's named endocrine cause of abnormal stature in children).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 33 requires a thorough workup to establish an underlying cause of fatigue; hypopituitarism (TSH/ACTH deficiency) is a classic endocrine cause of fatigue the objective's differential is expected to consider.

testable_competencies.pituitary_adenoma: Recognize pituitary adenoma mass effects (bitemporal hemianopsia, headache) and hormone-excess syndromes (PRL, GH, ACTH), with definitive management cross-referenced to Neurosurgery.
testable_competencies.hypopituitarism: Apply 'The Eight I's' etiology framework (including Sheehan's syndrome and pituitary apoplexy) and recognize axis-specific deficiency symptoms and the dynamic-testing approach to hypopituitarism.

entries.title: Thyroid Hormone Physiology

testable_competencies.thyroid_physiology: Recognize thyroid hormone synthesis, transport, and negative-feedback regulation as background for interpreting thyroid function tests.

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal physiology background framing the thyroid disease units that follow.

entries.title: Tests of Thyroid Function and Structure

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 63's enabling objectives require investigations to diagnose thyroid disease; TSH/free T4 interpretation and thyroid antibody/imaging tests are the objective's core investigation-selection task.

testable_competencies.tft_interpretation: Interpret TSH and free T4 patterns to localize thyroid dysfunction (primary vs. central) and select confirmatory antibody or imaging tests.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Thyrotoxicosis is the general hyperthyroid clinical syndrome underlying Objective 63's 'thyroid disease' causal category; this unit is the shared differential-diagnosis framework for the named etiologies that follow (SU-E-26 through SU-E-29).

testable_competencies.thyrotoxicosis_ddx: Generate a differential diagnosis for thyrotoxicosis (Graves', toxic adenoma/MNG, subacute thyroiditis, exogenous thyroid hormone) using clinical features and radioactive iodine uptake.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Graves' disease is the most common cause of hyperthyroidism and a classic named example under Objective 63's thyroid-disease causal category, matching its diagnose-and-manage enabling objective in full depth (orbitopathy, antithyroid drugs, radioactive iodine, surgery).

testable_competencies.graves_diagnosis: Recognize Graves' disease by hyperthyroid symptoms, diffuse goitre, and TSH-receptor antibodies, and recognize Graves' orbitopathy.
testable_competencies.graves_management: Select first-line management (antithyroid drugs, radioactive iodine ablation, or surgery) for Graves' disease based on patient factors.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: A named, self-limited cause of thyrotoxicosis under Objective 63's thyroid-disease category, distinguished from Graves' by absent/low radioactive iodine uptake and typically painful goitre.

testable_competencies.subacute_thyroiditis: Recognize subacute (de Quervain's) thyroiditis by painful goitre following a viral illness and its triphasic course (thyrotoxic, hypothyroid, recovery).

entries.title: Toxic Adenoma and Toxic Multinodular Goitre

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: A named cause of thyrotoxicosis under Objective 63 arising from autonomously functioning thyroid tissue, distinguished from Graves' by focal/multifocal uptake pattern.

testable_competencies.toxic_adenoma_mng: Distinguish toxic adenoma and toxic multinodular goitre from Graves' disease by radioactive iodine uptake pattern and select radioactive iodine or surgical management.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Thyroid storm is the life-threatening decompensation of untreated/undertreated thyrotoxicosis under Objective 63, matching the objective's requirement to determine 'severity and complications' at its most acute; a can't-miss emergency diagnosis.

testable_competencies.thyroid_storm: Recognize thyroid storm (fever, tachyarrhythmia, altered mental status in a thyrotoxic patient) and initiate emergency management (beta-blockade, thionamides, iodine, steroids).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Hypothyroidism is a high-frequency named presentation under Objective 63's thyroid-disease category, matching the objective's diagnose-cause-and-manage enabling objective in full depth (levothyroxine dosing and monitoring).

testable_competencies.hypothyroidism_diagnosis: Diagnose primary hypothyroidism using elevated TSH with low free T4, and distinguish from subclinical and central hypothyroidism.
testable_competencies.hypothyroidism_management: Initiate and titrate levothyroxine replacement, monitoring TSH at appropriate intervals.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Hashimoto's thyroiditis is the most common cause of hypothyroidism in iodine-sufficient regions and a classic named autoimmune etiology under Objective 63.

testable_competencies.hashimoto_diagnosis: Recognize Hashimoto's thyroiditis by elevated anti-TPO/anti-thyroglobulin antibodies and its association with other autoimmune disease.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Myxedema coma is the life-threatening decompensation of severe untreated hypothyroidism under Objective 63, matching the objective's severity/complications task at its most acute; a can't-miss emergency diagnosis.

testable_competencies.myxedema_coma: Recognize myxedema coma (altered mental status, hypothermia, bradycardia in a hypothyroid patient) and initiate emergency IV levothyroxine and stress-dose steroids.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: A component investigation-interpretation pitfall under Objective 63's thyroid-function-test enabling objective: distinguishing true thyroid disease from non-thyroidal illness in the critically ill patient.

testable_competencies.sick_euthyroid: Recognize sick euthyroid syndrome (abnormal TFTs in severe systemic illness without true thyroid disease) and avoid inappropriate thyroid hormone treatment.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 63's key objective is explicitly framed around 'a patient with a neck mass' with particular attention to 'excluding malignancy' - directly matching the thyroid-nodule evaluation algorithm (ultrasound risk stratification, fine needle aspiration) in this unit.

testable_competencies.thyroid_nodule_workup: Apply the thyroid nodule evaluation algorithm (TSH, ultrasound risk features, fine needle aspiration with Bethesda classification) to determine malignancy risk.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Malignant thyroid nodules/masses are explicitly the excluding-malignancy focus of Objective 63's key objective; thyroid cancer subtypes (papillary, follicular, medullary, anaplastic) are the definitive diagnoses this screening pathway is designed to catch.

testable_competencies.thyroid_cancer_subtypes: Distinguish papillary, follicular, medullary, and anaplastic thyroid carcinoma by prognosis and typical clinical behaviour, and recognize medullary thyroid cancer's association with MEN2.

entries.title: Adrenocortical Hormone Physiology

testable_competencies.adrenocortical_physiology: Recognize cortisol, aldosterone, and adrenal androgen synthesis and regulation as background for the adrenal cortex disease units that follow.

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal physiology background framing the adrenal cortex disease units that follow.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Adrenocortical functional testing (cosyntropin stimulation, dexamethasone suppression, aldosterone-renin ratio) is the investigation pathway for secondary hypertension causes named in Objective 9-1's causal_conditions ('adrenal adenoma/hyperplasia').

testable_competencies.adrenal_function_tests: Select and interpret cosyntropin stimulation testing (adrenal insufficiency), dexamethasone suppression testing (Cushing's), and aldosterone-renin ratio (primary aldosteronism).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 9-1's causal_conditions explicitly list 'adrenal adenoma/hyperplasia' among secondary hypertension causes, directly matching primary aldosteronism as a classic named cause of resistant/secondary hypertension.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Primary aldosteronism is a classic endocrine cause of hypokalemia matching Objective 79-2's urgency-recognition task for hypokalemia's neuromuscular complications.

testable_competencies.primary_aldosteronism: Recognize primary aldosteronism (Conn's syndrome) as a cause of resistant hypertension with hypokalemia, and apply the aldosterone-renin ratio screening test.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 9-1's causal_conditions list metabolic/endocrine secondary hypertension causes, and Cushing's syndrome is a classic named cause of secondary hypertension with a distinctive constellation of findings (central obesity, striae, easy bruising) matching the objective's severity/complications determination task.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 118-1's causal_conditions explicitly list 'Cushing syndrome' as a neuroendocrine cause of weight gain/obesity.

testable_competencies.cushing_diagnosis: Recognize Cushing's syndrome (central obesity, moon facies, striae, easy bruising, proximal myopathy) and apply the diagnostic algorithm (screening test, then localization to pituitary/adrenal/ectopic ACTH source).
testable_competencies.cushing_management: Distinguish exogenous (iatrogenic glucocorticoid) from endogenous Cushing's syndrome as the first diagnostic step, given its much higher prevalence.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia is an autosomal recessive single-gene enzyme-deficiency disorder (most commonly 21-hydroxylase deficiency) directly matching Objective 36's 'Monogenic (single gene mutations)' causal category, with the objective's task of recognizing at-risk populations (newborn screening) directly applicable.

testable_competencies.cah_recognition: Recognize congenital adrenal hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency) presenting with ambiguous genitalia, salt-wasting crisis in neonates, or precocious puberty/hirsutism in later-onset forms, and its glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid replacement management.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Hyperandrogenism (adrenal or ovarian source) is a recognized cause of oligomenorrhea/amenorrhea under Objective 56-1's causal_conditions ('ovarian dysgenesis, polycystic ovarian disease').

testable_competencies.hyperandrogenism_workup: Distinguish adrenal from ovarian sources of hyperandrogenism/hirsutism using DHEAS and testosterone levels, and recognize red-flag features suggesting an androgen-secreting tumour.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 33 requires a thorough workup to establish a cause of fatigue; adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease) is a classic, must-not-miss endocrine cause of chronic fatigue with life-threatening acute decompensation (adrenal crisis).

testable_competencies.addisons_recognition: Recognize primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease: fatigue, weight loss, hyperpigmentation, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia) and distinguish from secondary adrenal insufficiency (no hyperpigmentation, normal aldosterone axis).
testable_competencies.adrenal_crisis_management: Recognize adrenal crisis as a life-threatening emergency and initiate immediate IV hydrocortisone and fluid resuscitation without delaying treatment for confirmatory testing.

entries.title: Catecholamine Metabolism

testable_competencies.catecholamine_physiology: Recognize catecholamine synthesis and metabolism as background for interpreting pheochromocytoma biochemical testing (plasma/urine metanephrines).

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal physiology background framing the pheochromocytoma unit that follows.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 9-1's causal_conditions list adrenal secondary hypertension causes; pheochromocytoma is the classic named cause of episodic/paroxysmal hypertension with a distinctive triad (headache, palpitations, diaphoresis) matching the objective's severity/complications determination.

testable_competencies.pheo_recognition: Recognize pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma by the classic episodic triad (headache, palpitations, diaphoresis) with paroxysmal hypertension, and screen with plasma or urine fractionated metanephrines.
testable_competencies.pheo_perioperative: Recognize the need for alpha-blockade before beta-blockade and before surgical resection to prevent hypertensive crisis.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: MEN1/MEN2A/MEN2B are autosomal dominant single-gene syndromes directly matching Objective 36's 'Monogenic' causal category, with the objective's task of recognizing at-risk relatives directly applicable to MEN's classic tumour-triad screening.

testable_competencies.men_syndromes: Recognize the component tumours of MEN1 (parathyroid, pituitary, pancreatic), MEN2A (medullary thyroid cancer, pheochromocytoma, parathyroid), and MEN2B (medullary thyroid cancer, pheochromocytoma, mucosal neuromas/marfanoid habitus), and the rationale for family-member screening.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 12-2 is a direct, exact-title match ('Given a patient with either hypocalcemia or hypercalcemia, the candidate will diagnose the cause, severity, and complications') to this unit's content on hypercalcemia diagnosis and management.

testable_competencies.hypercalcemia_workup: Diagnose the cause of hypercalcemia (primary hyperparathyroidism vs. malignancy-associated most commonly) using PTH level as the initial discriminating test.
testable_competencies.hypercalcemia_management: Initiate emergency management of severe/symptomatic hypercalcemia (IV fluids, bisphosphonates, calcitonin).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 12-2 is a direct, exact-title match to this unit's content on hypocalcemia diagnosis and management (hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, and other causes).

testable_competencies.hypocalcemia_workup: Diagnose the cause of hypocalcemia (hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, CKD, and other causes) using PTH and vitamin D levels.
testable_competencies.hypocalcemia_management: Recognize and manage acute symptomatic hypocalcemia (tetany, Chvostek's/Trousseau's signs) with IV calcium replacement.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 74's age/sex-specific screening enabling objectives include bone-density screening as a preventive-health task; osteoporosis is the named high-frequency chronic-disease screening target this objective is designed to identify.

testable_competencies.osteoporosis_screening: Apply DEXA-based diagnostic criteria (T-score) and fracture risk assessment tools to screen for and diagnose osteoporosis.
testable_competencies.osteoporosis_management: Select first-line pharmacotherapy (bisphosphonates) for osteoporosis and counsel on calcium/vitamin D and lifestyle measures.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Osteomalacia/rickets result from the chronic hypocalcemia/vitamin D deficiency states covered under Objective 12-2's causal category, presenting as a bone-mineralization complication rather than the acute biochemical abnormality itself.

testable_competencies.osteomalacia_rickets: Distinguish osteomalacia (adults) from rickets (children) as defective bone mineralization typically due to vitamin D deficiency, and recognize characteristic radiographic findings (Looser zones).

entries.title: Renal Osteodystrophy

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 89-2 explicitly requires diagnosing CKD 'complications', and renal osteodystrophy is the named bone-mineral-disease complication of CKD; primary CKD staging/management belongs to the Nephrology chapter, so this unit covers only the bone-disease manifestation.

testable_competencies.renal_osteodystrophy: Recognize renal osteodystrophy as a bone-mineral complication of chronic kidney disease (secondary/tertiary hyperparathyroidism, altered vitamin D activation, phosphate retention).

entries.cross_discipline_note: Primary CKD diagnosis, staging, and management belong to the Nephrology chapter; this Endocrinology unit covers only the bone-mineral-disease manifestation.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: No dedicated MCC objective for Paget's disease exists; mapped as a component of Objective 74's periodic-health investigation-interpretation task (incidental elevated alkaline phosphatase workup) given its typically asymptomatic, incidentally-discovered presentation.

testable_competencies.pagets_disease: Recognize Paget's disease of bone as an incidental finding of isolated elevated alkaline phosphatase with normal calcium, and its characteristic radiographic findings and bisphosphonate management.

entries.title: Androgen Regulation and Tests of Testicular Function

testable_competencies.androgen_physiology: Recognize the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis and testicular-function testing (testosterone, LH, FSH, semen analysis) as background for the male reproductive endocrinology disease units that follow.

entries.zero_question_reason: Normal physiology and investigation background framing the male reproductive endocrinology disease units that follow.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 46's causal_conditions explicitly list male infertility causes; primary vs. secondary hypogonadism is the core diagnostic distinction (elevated vs. low/normal gonadotropins) this objective requires the candidate to make.

testable_competencies.male_hypogonadism_workup: Distinguish primary (testicular) from secondary (hypothalamic-pituitary) hypogonadism using LH/FSH and testosterone levels, and select testosterone replacement or fertility-preserving therapy accordingly.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 94's causal_conditions explicitly list 'Vascular insufficiency (e.g., diabetes)' and other erectile-dysfunction mechanisms, directly matching this unit's vascular/neurogenic/hormonal/psychogenic erectile dysfunction differential.

testable_competencies.ed_workup: Distinguish vascular, neurogenic, hormonal, and psychogenic causes of erectile dysfunction, and recognize ED as a potential marker of undiagnosed cardiovascular disease.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective 10-1's key objective explicitly names 'a breast mass or gynecomastia' verbatim, directly matching this unit's investigation algorithm (hCG, LH, testosterone, estradiol) and management.

testable_competencies.gynecomastia_workup: Apply the gynecomastia investigation algorithm (hCG, LH, testosterone, estradiol, thyroid function) to distinguish physiologic from pathologic causes, and select observation vs. medical vs. surgical management.

testable_competencies.female_repro_cross_ref: Recognize that female reproductive endocrinology content (PCOS, menstrual disorders, menopause) is covered in the Gynecology chapter, not duplicated here.

entries.cross_discipline_note: All substantive content (PCOS, menstrual disorders, menopause) belongs to the Gynecology chapter (Toronto Notes cross-reference: 'see Gynecology, GY23').

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Table 40 explicitly lists paraneoplastic hypoglycemia (insulin/IGF2-secreting tumours) matching Objective 129's endogenous-hyperinsulinism-cause differential.

testable_competencies.endocrine_paraneoplastic_recognition: Recognize the endocrine paraneoplastic syndromes (ectopic ACTH/Cushing's, SIADH, PTHrP-mediated hypercalcemia, insulin/IGF2-mediated hypoglycemia) and their associated malignancies (small cell lung cancer prominently) as a cause-to-investigate when a patient presents with the corresponding electrolyte/hormonal abnormality.
